limits: Canonical Pillow BC1-with-alpha/BC3 software decode, not a native GPU decoding/visual certificate.
Every authored mip retains its own size, compressed block identity and RGBA; no resize, generated mips, gamma conversion or premultiplication.
Source mesh points/indices/face UV/material bytes/RGB/pivot/header and unparsed tail are retained. No normals, pivot offset, reflection, winding, unit scale or emitter/material behavior is applied.
Private decode only; no public files or runtime bindings.
